title: Nanometanf validation_results.json
description: Canonical contract for the JSON document produced by the AGGREGATE_VALIDATION_RESULTS module. nanometa_live and any other downstream consumer reads this file at results/validation/validation_results.json. The schema is the source of truth for the cross-component contract; the writer at modules/local/aggregate_validation_results/main.nf and the consumer at nanometa_live/core/parsers/blast_validation_parser.py both reference it.

pipeline_version.description: nanometanf pipeline version string from workflow.manifest.version. "dev" when the manifest is unset.

validation_method.description: Validation methods that were exercised in this run. ``both`` indicates BLAST and minimap2 results coexist per (sample, taxid) entry.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the aggregator ran.

hit_rate.description: Validation hit-rate threshold from params.validation_hit_rate_threshold (default 0.5). A read passes hit-rate filtering when at least this fraction of its alignments cleared the identity bar.

identity.description: Percent-identity threshold from params.validation_identity_threshold (default 90.0). On amplicon protocols the short-amplicon audit recommends 80.0 -- short ONT reads carry more end-of-read Q-score noise.

results.description: Two-level nested map: sample_id -> taxid (as string) -> per-(sample, taxid) result. Empty when no validation ran. Sample IDs are operator-supplied (e.g. ``barcode01``); taxid keys are the integer NCBI taxid serialised as a string for JSON-object-key compatibility.

total_samples.description: Distinct sample_id values present in results.

total_taxids_validated.description: Sum of distinct taxid keys across all samples (a (sample, taxid) pair counts once).

confirmed.description: Number of (sample, taxid) entries with validation_status == "confirmed". For dual-method runs the BLAST validation_status is counted; minimap2_status is a sibling field.

ValidationEntry.description: One (sample, taxid) validation result. Required fields are present in every entry; method-specific fields are present only when that method ran.

taxid.description: NCBI taxonomy ID. Echoes the dictionary key but typed as integer. Note: when the run uses a GTDB Kraken2 database, this carries the GTDB-mapped taxid which may differ from the NCBI taxid the operator selected in the watchlist; nanometa_live's TaxidMapper handles the inverse lookup.

species.description: Species name extracted from the Kraken2 report. Empty string when the taxid was not found at species rank in any report.

validation_method.description: Primary validation method for this entry. When both BLAST and minimap2 ran for the same (sample, taxid), the entry is keyed on whichever wrote first; the other method's stats appear as the minimap2_* sibling fields.

kraken_reads.description: Reads classified to this taxid by Kraken2 (per the per-read assignment file).

extracted_reads.description: Reads successfully extracted by EXTRACT_READS_BY_TAXID for downstream validation. Should equal kraken_reads in normal operation; lower values indicate an extraction failure (rare).

blast_hits.description: BLAST mode only. Number of extracted reads that produced at least one BLAST hit clearing the identity threshold.

mapped_reads.description: Minimap2 mode only. Number of extracted reads that aligned to the reference with MAPQ >= params.minimap2_min_mapq.

hit_rate.description: Fraction of extracted reads that produced a hit (blast_hits / extracted_reads or mapped_reads / extracted_reads). Compared to thresholds.hit_rate to set validation_status.

avg_identity.description: Mean percent identity across all hits. Compared to thresholds.identity to set validation_status.

avg_coverage.description: Mean fraction of the read covered by its best hit (BLAST) or alignment (minimap2).

avg_mapq.description: Minimap2 mode only. Mean MAPQ of accepted alignments. Range follows minimap2 convention (0-60).

ref_name.description: Minimap2 mode only. Reference contig / chromosome name the reads aligned to. Empty when no alignments produced.

ref_length.description: Minimap2 mode only. Reference sequence length in bp. Used by nanometa_live's coverage plots.

minimap2_mapped.description: Dual-method mode only (validation_method == "blast" entries also carrying minimap2 stats). Equivalent of mapped_reads from the minimap2 pass.

minimap2_hit_rate.description: Dual-method mode only. minimap2 hit_rate for the same (sample, taxid).

minimap2_identity.description: Dual-method mode only. minimap2 avg_identity for the same (sample, taxid).

minimap2_status.description: Dual-method mode only. minimap2 validation_status for the same (sample, taxid).

validation_status.description: Final verdict for this (sample, taxid). ``confirmed`` when hit_rate >= thresholds.hit_rate AND avg_identity >= thresholds.identity. ``rejected`` when hit_rate is well below threshold. ``uncertain`` for borderline cases. ``unknown`` is a fallback when the writer could not classify.
